note: Literature indicates classic limb reduction defects are primarily linked to NIPBL mutations and absent or atypical in non-NIPBL CdLS like MAU2.

evidence.text: Correlations between clinical phenotype and molecular etiology in CdLS demonstrate that classical limb reduction defects are largely restricted to specific NIPBL variants, whereas individuals with variants in cohesin-associated genes like MAU2 typically present with non-classic phenotypes.

evidence.text: Major limb defects in Cornelia de Lange syndrome are specifically documented in individuals with truncating NIPBL variants, distinguishing them from other genetic subtypes.
